encounters.weakness: Plasma Pulse (Player's weapon). The Wraith's code structure is disrupted when exposed to high-frequency plasma pulses. Pulse must be aimed at its central 'glitch node' (visible as a pulsing red point).

Micro-Hack Pen (pickup from previous encounter). The enforcer's bio-mechanical interface can be hacked when exposed to the pen during a low-power state. This state is only achieved if the Flicker Core was used during the previous encounter. Hacking lasts 3 seconds and drains the pen's battery (rechargeable only after 30 seconds).
inventory: Flicker Core (Stable Data Node - Level 1, Unstable with time). Can be used to stabilize system nodes, unlocking hidden doors. If used outside of a critical system, it may cause a temporary data burst (10% chance of triggering a system crash).

encounters.weakness: None. Uses illusions and AI mimicry. Can phase into player's gear or project false enemies. Attacks are random and adaptive.
inventory: Flicker Core (Stable Data Node - Level 1, Unstable with time). Can be used to stabilize system nodes, unlocking hidden doors. If used outside of a critical system, it may cause a temporary data burst (10% chance of triggering a system crash).

Neural Resonance Drive (Bio-Link Inhibitor - Level 1). Emits a low-frequency pulse. Effective against bio-mechanical enemies. Can be used to disable the Enforcer's nanite sprays. Requires 5 seconds to charge, then can be held to disrupt systems for 3 seconds.

encounters.weakness: The player's Neural Sync Blade (weapon) emits a low-frequency pulse that disrupts the swarm's central AI core. A single strike to the drone's chest node triggers a full system collapse and disables the swarm for 3 seconds. The blade must be used in a specific sequence: stab + rapid tap to trigger pulse mode.
inventory: Neural Sync Blade (melee weapon that emits a low-frequency pulse, weak against AI systems)

encounters.weakness: The Fragmented Data Shard (pickup from previous encounter) can be used to short-circuit the enforcer's cybernetic core. When the shard is inserted into the enforcer's chest port (a rare tech slot), it creates a temporary data surge that disables their adaptive armor for 5 seconds. The player must use the shard within 8 seconds of engagement or the enforcer gains 30% armor regeneration and becomes immune to all blade strikes.
inventory: Neural Sync Blade (melee weapon that emits a low-frequency pulse, weak against AI systems)

encounters.weakness: None (but only triggers if the player uses the Fragmented Data Shard and Neural Sync Blade in tandem). The entity appears as a shifting, translucent figure made of corrupted data. It mimics the player's movements and attacks by copying their last action. If the player uses the blade and shard together, it creates a 'resonance burst' that collapses its form into a core. However, if the player fails to do so, it spawns a drone swarm that reactivates the first encounter and resets the player's inventory (forcing re-engagement with the first enemy).
inventory: Neural Sync Blade (melee weapon that emits a low-frequency pulse, weak against AI systems)

encounters.weakness: Circuit-Scrap Wrench (player's weapon). Use it to 'scrap' the enemy's energy blade, causing a 30% reduction in damage output. The Glaive's blade flickers and dies when the wrench is swung at it in the dark alley.

Data Fragments (acquired in Encounter 1). When the Echo-Skimmer intercepts a fragment, it echoes a corrupted memory of the player's own past, causing it to hesitate. Use the fragment to 'reflect' the enemy's signal back to the city network to disrupt it for 3 seconds.
inventory: Circuit-Scrap Wrench (Stolen from a dead AI-construct in the alley wall).

encounters.weakness: Circuit-Scrap Key (acquired in Encounter 2). When the player holds the key in their hand during combat, the Warden's armor begins to vibrate and the key emits a low-frequency pulse that disables its power core for 5 seconds. This must be done *before* the Warden begins its full-phase attack.
inventory: Circuit-Scrap Wrench (Stolen from a dead AI-construct in the alley wall).
Data Fragment (Recovered from a crashed drone that flickered into memory as you passed).
